english_outline.section1: Samsung Q2 2026 revenue KRW 171.5tn, operating profit KRW 89.5tn, both record highs. Reuters reports 19-fold profit jump but shares fell over $80bn in market value on AI sustainability concerns.
english_outline.section2: DS Division revenue KRW 127.5tn, operating profit KRW 89.2tn. Memory record on AI server demand and rising prices. HBM4 sales scaled, HBM4E samples shipped. Foundry improved on HBM base-die and US orders. MX revenue KRW 33.2tn but operating loss KRW 0.7tn on component costs. SDC revenue KRW 7.5tn, profit KRW 0.7tn. VD/DA slight loss.
english_outline.section3: Memory expects undersupply to persist in H2 2026 on AI capex. Foundry targets double-digit revenue growth. MX faces rising costs and soft demand. SDC to ramp 8.6G IT OLED. These shape growth, margin, and cash flow expectations.
english_outline.section4: Reuters: shares slumped despite profit beat, over $80bn market value wiped. Analysts cited by Reuters noted HBM growth tightening conventional memory supply and supporting prices, but foundry and LSI losses likely widened on bonus expenses.
english_outline.section5: Key Q3 validation: HBM4/HBM4E ramp and pricing, foundry 2nm ramp and order momentum, MX cost mitigation and flagship sales, memory supply constraints versus demand moderation.

reader_questions: 路透社报道的"营业利润同比增长约19倍"与官方口径的"创历史新高"是否指向同一统计基础？若不同，稿件能否将两者并列使用？
路透社报道的"市值蒸发超过800亿美元"发生在哪一天、对应哪个股价基准？该数字能否与7月30日发布的Q2正式业绩直接挂钩？
稿件称"代工和逻辑芯片（LSI）业务亏损可能因奖金费用分摊而扩大"，但官方口径称代工在激励相关拨备前盈利显著改善、System LSI上半年营收创纪录，两者是否矛盾？
checks: 核查：官方来源仅给出Q2营收171.5万亿韩元、营业利润89.5万亿韩元、每股收益10,849韩元（增长52%）及"another all-time high"，未提供同比倍数。路透社标题与摘要中的"19-fold jump"出现在7月6日的业绩预告报道中，属预告口径，与7月30日正式业绩并非同一统计基础。修订稿删除"同比增幅约19倍"，仅保留官方"创历史新高"表述。
核查：路透社摘要显示该报道日期为2026年7月6日，标题为"Samsung flags 19-fold jump in profit, but shares slump"，其"抹去超过800亿美元市值"对应的是业绩预告发布后的股价反应，而非7月30日正式财报发布日。修订稿明确标注该股价反应发生于业绩预告阶段，不与正式业绩混同。

核查：官方来源称Foundry"Earnings ... improved significantly prior to incentive-related provisions"，System LSI"driving first-half revenue to a record high"；路透社摘要则称分析师预计代工与LSI亏损"likely to widen because bonus expenses are allocated across the semiconductor"。两者分别描述拨备前与拨备后口径，并不矛盾。修订稿并列呈现两个口径，并说明差异来源。
